text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
So, I've already decided on where to take 
the photo. Since it's a kimono, it has to 
be—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...! Wait, Sweep-san. I hear someone 
crying over there...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Huh, Kitasan?!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: ...*sniff*. Waaah, Mommy...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay, little guy? Your mommy... 
doesn't seem to be around. Are you lost?

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: I'm not lost!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh? B-But... didn't you get separated 
from your mommy...?

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but...! I'm... still not lost!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What's with this kid? You got separated 
from your mom, yet you say you're not 
lost? That makes zero sense!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... what should we do? Should we head 
over to the police box for help...?

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: I'm not lost! Why won't anyone understand!

text_block_list.name: Young Sweep
text_block_list.text:
(No! No, no, no, no! Why won't anybody 
understand?!!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You just hate the fact that you got lost 
in the first place, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Being lost feels childish and 
embarrassing... and the nicer people are 
to you, the more miserable you feel, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
S-Shut up...! What would you know, big 
sis!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Don't underestimate me. I know. Of course 
I know! Which is why—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "Pride☆Camellia"!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Whoa...?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That was magic to protect your pride. 
You've actually got some real guts!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But running away isn't cool at all! If 
you're going to protect your pride, stand 
your ground and see it through!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...I'll teach you one more magic 
incantation for that. Lend me your ear—

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Found you! Mommy...!

text_block_list.name: Boy's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank goodness... there you are! I've 
been looking everywhere!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
...Uh-uh! Mommy got lost, so me and the 
big sisters came looking for you!

text_block_list.name: Boy's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe...! Excuse us, but could you 
please just let him have this one?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still, that was quite the unique spell! To 
think the incantation was "Stubbornly 
Stand Your Ground"...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What's the big deal? It solved the 
problem, didn't it! Besides—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...It doesn't matter. Even if you seem 
selfish or get scolded, as long as you 
have pride in your heart.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
If you have pride, you don't have to run 
away. And if you don't run away... someone 
will definitely listen to you.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...You know, Sweep-san, you felt 
even more festival-level dependable than 
usual today!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's that supposed to mean? Well, 
whatever—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I am a grown-up, after all. A splendid 
adult who makes Grandma proud!

A few days later—Sweep Tosho sent a photo 
over LANE. It was likely the photo she 
promised to send to her grandmother.

Standing proudly in the picture was an 
unrecognizable, wonderfully mature Sweep 
Tosho...!

...Looking closely, there was another 
message attached.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"See that? I'm an adult, proud, and the 
coolest witch in the whole wide world!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "Don't you ever forget it!"

...Shortly after, one more photo came 
through.

It showed Sweep Tosho, Kitasan Black, and 
an unfamiliar young boy...
choice_data_list: I wonder what this picture is from? But...

text_block_list.text:
The expression on Sweep Tosho's face was 
just as proud and triumphant as in the 
kimono photo.
